body:
# FoliaShop

A modern, high-performance shop plugin built for **Folia**, **Paper**, and modern Minecraft servers.

FoliaShop combines a powerful GUI shop, Worthify-style selling system, Auction House, BuffedItems integration, SmartSpawner support, advanced item matching, and an in-game editor into one complete economy solution.

---

# ✨ Features

## 🛒 Shop System

* Beautiful paged GUI shops
* Buy and sell items directly from categories
* Unlimited custom shop categories
* Search system with GUI and commands
* Per-category permissions
* Category shortcut commands
* Nested categories and subcategories
* Fully configurable menus

## 💰 Worth System

* Built-in Worthify-style worth values
* Shop sell prices take priority automatically
* Fallback `worth.yml` support
* Supports vanilla and custom items
* BuffedItems worth integration
* `/worth` GUI for browsing values
* Shared pricing system for `/sellall` and `/sellgui`

## 📦 Selling System

* `/sellall` inventory selling
* `/sellgui` drag-and-sell interface
* Bulk selling support
* Partial stack selling support
* Custom sell hooks and commands
* Action bar, chat, and sound feedback

## 🏷️ Auction House

* Player-driven economy
* Sell items with `/ah sell <price>`
* Auction search system
* Sorting and filtering options
* Personal listing management
* Configurable listing limits
* Expired item recovery
* Permission-based limits

## 🛠️ In-Game Editor

* Create categories without editing YAML
* Edit prices, slots, names, lore, and permissions
* Add held items instantly
* GUI-based administration
* Sign and chat input support
* Bedrock-friendly fallback editor

## ⚔️ Advanced Item Support

* BuffedItems integration
* SmartSpawner integration
* Saved custom items
* Custom model data support
* Namespaced tags
* NBT-aware item matching
* Advanced metadata handling

### Matching Options

Choose how selling and shop detection works:

* Material Matching
* Display Name Matching
* Lore Matching
* Custom Model Data Matching
* NBT / PDC Matching
* Exact Item Matching

Perfect for RPG, Survival, Skyblock, OneBlock, Prison, and custom economy servers.

---

## Economy

* Vault
* Any Vault-compatible economy plugin
* XP Levels Economy
* XP Points Economy

## Custom Items

* BuffedItems

* SmartSpawner

## Permissions

* LuckPerms
* Any Bukkit Permission Plugin

## Placeholder Support

* PlaceholderAPI

## Bedrock Support

* Geyser
* Floodgate
* Bedrock Edition Clients

* Vault

---

# ⌨️ Commands

## Player Commands

```text
/shop
/fshop
/sellall
/sellgui
/worth
/ah
```

## Admin Commands

```text
/fshop editor
/fshop addheld
/fshop addbuffed
/fshop setprice
/fshop reload
```

---

# 🔐 Permissions

```text
foliashop.use
foliashop.admin
foliashop.auction.use
foliashop.auction.sell
foliashop.auction.admin
```

Supports LuckPerms and permission-based shop access.

---

# 🚀 Why FoliaShop?

Unlike traditional shop plugins, FoliaShop was designed specifically for modern Minecraft servers and Folia's async architecture.

It provides a complete economy ecosystem:

* GUI Shops
* Worth System
* Sell GUI
* Sell All
* Auction House
* Custom Item Support
* Advanced Matching
* In-Game Editor

All while remaining lightweight, scalable, and highly configurable.

Whether you're running a Survival server, Skyblock, OneBlock, Prison, RPG server, or a custom SMP, FoliaShop provides everything needed to power your economy.
